content.title: Huntrix, Saja Boys; When is McDonald's 'KPop Demon Hunters' meal out?
content.text: March 25, 2026, 3:25 p.m. ETMcDonald's and Netflix are letting Hunters and The Pride duke it out with the release of a limited-edition Happy Meal in a KPop battle between Huntr/X and Saja Boys with new toys inside on Tuesday, March 31, 2026.Inspired by the Netflix film "KPop Demon Hunters" and the girls who make up the fictional K-pop group HUNTR/X — Rumi, Mira and Zoey — the new adult McDonald's Happy Meal will feature collectible photocards when it heads to a McDonald's near you on Tuesday. More a Saja Boys fan? If you love Jinu, Mystery, Abby, Romance, and Baby, you can snag a Saja Boys Breakfast Meal next week — complete with spicy sauce inspired by Demon King Gwi-Ma.McDonald's newest Happy Meal is an adult Happy Meal, meaning Happy Meal toys aren't inside; however, fans can collect HUNTER/X and Saja Boys Photocards and gain exclusive access via a Derpy card — where you can find out who wins the "Battle for the Fans" between Kpop's HUNTER/X and the Saja Boys.Ready to give a spicy umami Ramyeon McShaker fries a spin or anxious to dunk your McDonald's McNuggets in two brand-new sauces, one colored purple? Here's what to know about the "KPop Demon Hunters" meal at McDonald's and how Huntrix fans can snag a brand-new Derpy Tiger McFlurry treat.When does McDonald's 'KPop Demon Hunters' meal come out?McDonald's 'KPop Demon Hunters" meals come out Tuesday, March 31, 2026. The new adult Happy Meals — HUNTR/X Meal and the Saja Boys Breakfast Meal — will be available nationwide at participating restaurants for a limited time.What's in the 'KPop Demon Hunters' McDonald's meals?Fans who purchased a "KPop Demon Hunter" meal at McDonald's on March 31 can choose between the HUNTR/X Meal or the Saja Boys McDonald's Breakfast Meal:Huntr/X Meal: 10-piece McDonald's Chicken McNuggets, medium soft drink and Ramyeon McShaker Fries, with a spicy, umani spin featuring soy, garlic, sesame and spice seasoning. The fries are inspired by Rumi, Zoey and Mira's go-to noodle snack. You'll sprinkle the seasoning into a McShaker bag, throw in the fries and shake away.Hunter Sauce and Demon Sauce: The "K Pop Demon Hunter" meal comes with both sauces, with the Hunter Sauce a sweet chili mix, and the Demon Sauce a bold mustard colored purple.The Saja Boys Breakfast Meal: A Sausage McMuffin with Egg, topped with a peppery Spicy Saja Sauce. You also get hash browns and a small soft drink (a little "Soda Pop" to cool down, of course)Is it a 'KPop Demon Hunter' Happy Meal? Are there McDonald's Happy Meal toys?While McDonald's Happy Meals come with toys, the "KPop Demon Hunters" meals are adult Happy Meals, with larger portions that, for this specific meal, come with collectible card packs consisting of an exclusive photocard for either HUNTR/X or the Saja Boys and an exclusive Derpy access card.The Derpy card — inspired by the Hunters' lovable Derpy Tiger — provides a unique QR code to scan on the McDonald's App. Fans must scan the code by April 26 to unlock first access to exclusive "KPop Demon Hunter" content and see who wins the "Battle for the Fans" between HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys.How much does the 'KPop Demon Hunter' meal 2026 cost?The cost of the "KPop Demon Hunters" adult Happy meal varies by location. When previous McDonald's Happy Meals for adults dropped, such as "The Grinch," and "Mcdonaldland," the price was between $15 and $17 across McDonald's in New Jersey. When the meal drops, check the McDonald's app, find your location to check how much it'll cost.What's in the new 'KPop Demon Hunters" McFlurry at McDonalds? Derpy McFlurryMcDonald's new "Derpy McFlurry" will come out March 31, offering "KPop Demon Hunters" fans a creamy vanilla soft serve with blackberry popping pearls, all mixed in a wild berry sauce. The new "KPop Demon Hunters" McFlurry at McDonald's is inspired by fan-favorite Derpy Tiger from the popular animated film.What is Huntrix? Is HUNTR/X a real band?Whether you knew the song name or not, you've probably listened to HUNTR/X "Golden" a million times — it won a 2026 Oscar, after all — and know by now the "KPop Demon Hunters" is an animated film on Netflix, right?The Netflix movie follows the musical girl group — Rumi, Mira and Zoey — as they juggle their lives as superstars and use their hidden identities as demon hunters to protect fans from supernatural threats, like sealing the Honmoon to avoid demons from coming in.Rumi, Mira and Zoey, or the girl group HUNTR/X (fans call them Huntrix) are not real people; however, the voices behind HUNTR/X are: Mira is voiced by May Hong, with Audrey Nuna singing, Rumi is voiced by Arden Cho with EJAE singing) and Zoey is voiced by Ji-young Yoo and sang by Rei Ami).And fans can get even more excited: A "KPop Demon Hunters" sequel is officially in the works.Who are the Saja Boys?The Saja Boys are a fictional five-member K-pop boy band featured in the Netflix film "KPop Demon Hunters." The leader is Jinu, a former human who made a pact with Demon King Gwi-Ma, trading his soul for his singing voice. He is joined by main dancer Abby (Abs), Romance, the flirty one with pink hair, Baby Saja, the main rapper and youngest member, and Mystery, the "elusive" member often shrouded in enigma.The boys, who sing "Your Idol and "Soda Pop," have a primary objective to weaken the magical barrier known as the Honmoon, serving as the primary antagonists to Huntr/X.How to find a McDonald's near me in NJIs there a McDonald's near me? It's likely since there are over 250 McDonald's locations in New Jersey. To find a McDonald's near you and to grab the new HUNTER/X and Saja Boys meal in New Jersey, visit McDonald's online locator.Lori Comstock is a New Jersey-based journalist with the Mid-Atlantic Connect Team.
